phase_name: Predictive Impact Analysis & Mission Change Simulation

risk_model.description: Multi-dimensional risk assessment evaluating 9 explicit operational factors without LLM score hallucinations.

dimensions.name: scope_score
dimensions.criteria: NONE=0, LOCAL=5, CROSS_FILE=12, CROSS_MODULE=20, ARCHITECTURAL=28, MISSION_WIDE=30

dimensions.name: security_score
dimensions.criteria: Keywords auth, jwt, sentinel, permission, credentials evaluate to 22.0 points

dimensions.name: architecture_score
dimensions.criteria: API contract modifications, protocol switching, or architectural scope trigger 14.0 points

dimensions.name: state_score
dimensions.criteria: Database schema mutations, migrations, or SQLite table updates trigger 9.0 points

dimensions.name: evidence_invalidation_score
dimensions.criteria: min(10.0, invalidated_evidence_count * 3.5) enforcing Zero False Success

dimensions.name: rollback_complexity_score
dimensions.criteria: Task cancellation or removal triggers 8.0 points

dimensions.name: concurrency_score
dimensions.criteria: Active worker execution in RUNNING state triggers 8.0 points

dimensions.name: economic_score
dimensions.criteria: 4 or more additional DAG tasks evaluate to 4.0 points

thresholds.CRITICAL: total_score >= 75.0 or direct security bypass threat
thresholds.MEDIUM: total_score >= 30.0 or architecture_score >= 12.0 or active evidence invalidated

risk_model.human_approval_policy: Mandatory for HIGH and CRITICAL risk levels, or when scope is ARCHITECTURAL or MISSION_WIDE.
